import numpy as np,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    import os,re
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
gi=np.array(G['Test input'])
T={(y,x) for y in range(9) for x in range(15) if gi[y][x]==0}
B={(y,x) for y in range(10,19) for x in range(15) if gi[y][x]==6}
# normalize both masks to bounding boxes
def norm(S):
    ys=[p[0] for p in S]; xs=[p[1] for p in S]
    y0,y1,x0,x1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
    return {(y-y0,x-x0) for y,x in S}, (y0,x0,y1,y1,x1,y1)
Nt,_=norm(T); Nb,_=norm(B)
print('T size',len(Nt),'B size',len(Nb))
# try all translations of B onto T grid: max overlap
best=0; bestt=None
for dy in range(-9,10):
    for dx in range(-15,16):
        o=len({(y+dy,x+dx) for y,x in Nb}&T)
        if o>best: best,bestt=o,(dy,dx)
print('best translate-overlap:',best,bestt,'of',len(T),len(Nb))
# correlation: dot product over whole frame
top=np.zeros((9,15),dtype=int); bot=np.zeros((9,15),dtype=int)
for y,x in T: top[y][x]=1
for y,x in B: bot[y-10][x]=1
import scipy
corr=scipy.signal.correlate2d(top,bot,mode='same')
zc,zi=np.unravel_index(np.argmax(corr),corr.shape); print('max corr',zc,zi,'val',corr[zc,zi])
